sources.title: Input files for Dispa-SET for the JRC report Power System Flexibility in a variable climate
sources.citation: Matteo De Felice (2020), Input files for Dispa-SET for the JRC report Power System Flexibility in a variable climate, Zenodo v1, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.3775569. Related report: De Felice, M.; Busch, S.; Kanellopoulos, K.; Kavvadias, K.; Hidalgo Gonzalez, I., EUR 30184 EN, JRC120338, DOI 10.2760/75312.
sources.model_scope: Regional Dispa-SET unit-commitment/dispatch input data. Official description covers climate years 1990-2015, plant parameters, availability, hourly load, outages, fuel/CO2 prices, inter-zonal transfer capacities and flows, reservoir levels and hydro inflows. Not a bus-level IEEE SCUC benchmark; CO2 price inputs do not by themselves establish an emissions-cap model.
upstream_caveats: EnVarClim.yml is a template; paths and XXXX climate-year placeholders require later configuration.
Upstream documents extra Western Balkans NTC rows ending in 1, ignored by its model because they do not map to simulated zones. Preserve originals; no correction made.
Some Western Balkans time series repeat across climate years, per the publisher.
Separate upstream results record is not downloaded in this batch.

sources.title: LEGO - Low-carbon Expansion Generation Optimization: official model and prepared case studies
sources.license: MIT repository license; retain complete upstream LICENSE and notices
sources.citation: S. Wogrin, D. Tejada-Arango, R. Gaugl, T. Klatzer, U. Bachhiesl (2022), LEGO: The open-source Low-carbon Expansion Generation Optimization model, SoftwareX 19, 101141, DOI 10.1016/j.softx.2022.101141. Copyright (c) 2022 IEE-TUGraz; preserve MIT LICENSE.
institutional_affiliations: Institute of Electricity Economics and Energy Innovation, Graz University of Technology
sources.model_scope: Official prepared stylized-system examples plus GAMS model. Current root has 1LRP, 7LRP and Hourly case ZIPs. README identifies seven representative days and chronological full-year variants; model supports optional UC, storage, demand-side management, inertia, hydrogen and expansion planning. Capabilities are not certification that every supplied case activates every module.
upstream_caveats: PreviousData/EnStOpInvMo-7LRP-kmeans-net.xlsm belongs to an older model and is explicitly incompatible with the current LEGO.gms, per README.
Three time-representation packages are not three independent physical systems.
Original macro-enabled workbooks and GAMS files are preserved, never executed here.
